svg.text: ARCHITECTURE ATLAS · 03 / 04 · SLIDES 12, 15, 48 & 52
Open Protocol Interoperability: MCP v1.0 (Agent ↔ Tool) & A2A v1.0 (Agent ↔ Agent)
GA in Foundry Agent Service · Assistants API retired 2026-08-26 · Full Responses API, Activity Protocol, MCP & Linux Foundation A2A v1.0
MCP v1.0 — Model Context Protocol (Agent ↔ Tool)
1. Hosted MCP Tools (Foundry Managed — mcp.ai.azure.com)
• Zero local process management; cloud-hosted by Microsoft Foundry
• Native support in Responses API & Foundry Agent Service providers
• Catalog includes Azure DevOps MCP, SharePoint Grounding, Fabric Data Agent
4 Auth Modes: Key · Entra Agent Identity · Managed Identity · OAuth OBO Passthrough
2. Local / Self-Hosted MCP Tools + APIM Zero-Trust Gateway
• Connects to any MCP server over stdio or Streamable HTTP/SSE
• Universal compatibility: works across all 8+ IChatClient providers
• Azure API Management (APIM) acts as Zero-Trust MCP Gateway
7 Tool Classes × 8+ Providers (AOAI, Resp, Foundry, Claude, Ollama, Copilot)
3. Hierarchical Agent-as-Tool Composition (Slide 46 & 48)
• C# .NET: agent.AsAIFunction() | Python: agent.as_tool()
• Wraps any specialist AIAgent (with its own tools/session) as a typed
function tool for parent orchestrators + L2 HITL tool approval gates.
A2A Protocol v1.0 — Agent2Agent (Linux Foundation)
1. Cryptographically Signed Agent Cards (JWS Trust Anchor)
• Standardized JSON metadata at /.well-known/agent-card.json
• Advertises capability discovery, input/output modalities & skill schemas
• JWS digital signatures prevent endpoint spoofing & MITM card tampering
Benchmark Verified: 100% detection of tampered A2A endpoint signatures
2. Three Equivalent Transport Bindings & Enterprise Auth
HTTP / REST
JSON-RPC 2.0
gRPC
• Multi-tenant isolation + OAuth 2.0 (PKCE, Device Code) + mutual TLS (mTLS)
• Linux Foundation TSC: Microsoft, Google, AWS, Cisco, IBM, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow
3. MAF A2AAgent Proxy — Cross-Cloud & Cross-Framework Federation
• Wraps any remote A2A endpoint as a native local AIAgent instance
• Seamless federation across Foundry Agent Service, Copilot Studio,
LangGraph, CrewAI, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, and Google Vertex AI Agent Engine
Inbound & Outbound A2A v1.0 Endpoints GA in Foundry Agent Service
